CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content was found.

COD.rationale: Content (positioned red set), an organization pattern (cluster of coordinates) and an explicit origin/status string for the same referent/time are present in the text.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition statement tied to the same identified content's organization/presentation/access was found.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit lines identify contents (red/blue) and their coordinate attributes for named referents/times.

D.rationale: The report separately records origin/status metadata (copied_prior_record, history_estimate, command_estimate) distinct from content coordinate listings.

O.rationale: Coordinate groupings and repeated candidate/current enumerations describe how content is organized/presented as spatial patterns for named referents/times.
